entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand tracker. It's not working for me and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
I don't have time to play 20 questions. I want to return it. That's all you need to know. Pull up my account, my name is Mark Shapiro. Just process the return.

Okay, Mr. Shapiro. I'm pulling up your account now... I see your VeloBand GPS Tracker was delivered on December 15th, which was 42 days ago. I'm very sorry, but our updated return policy for wearable devices is quite strict.
What are you talking about? Strict how?

Well, due to hygiene and sanitation concerns with products worn on the skin, the return window is 20 days. Because it's been 42 days, it's unfortunately too late to accept it back. That's the official policy.

ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! That is absolute garbage! The website said 10 days when I bought it! I am a VIP member, for crying out loud! I've spent thousands with you people! This is unacceptable! Get me your manager right now, or I swear I will light up every review site on the internet about this scam!
Sir, I understand your frustration, please let me just take another look. You are right, you are one of our VIP members and I want to be absolutely certain I'm not missing anything. One moment.

Okay... ah. My sincere apologies, Mr. Shapiro. You are completely correct. I was mistakenly referencing the policy for our brand new Pulse line of heart-rate monitors. For your VeloBand GPS Tracker, the 10-day return policy is still in effect. I am so sorry for that confusion.
Damn right I'm correct. So are you going to fix this or are you going to keep wasting my time?

I'm fixing it right now. I have approved the return. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label as we speak. Just send the device back in its original box, and you'll receive a full refund once it's processed at our warehouse. And for my error and the frustration this has caused, I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account. We truly do value your business.
Fine. A credit is... acceptable. Just make sure that refund doesn't get delayed.
I will personally monitor it. The refund will be processed the moment the return is logged in our system. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
